message_excerpt: Fix allowedImportAdditions being dropped during PolicyEntry reconstruction
proposition: PUT /policies/{policyId}/entries/{label}: contract says the PolicyEntry request permits allowedImportAdditions to specify permitted imported additions; implementation does reconstruct the submitted entry from subjects, resources and importable while omitting allowedImportAdditions
